issue.headline: ChatGPT gets a wallet, and Skylight has already planned 48.5 million dinners
issue.brief: A Saturday with real news. OpenAI replaced Instant Checkout with ChatGPT Wallet, a tokenized card plus Face ID approval that lets its agents pay for US Pro users. Skylight put 20 Joanna Gaines recipes on its Target calendar and revealed 48.5 million meals planned, 33.5 million of them in the past year. Apple promised a December fix after Siri on HomeView refused to open a reviewer's garage, Alexa's text shopping went wide in 13 countries including Canada, and a Tyson survey says 72% of parents already ask AI for holiday cooking help.

zh.headline: ChatGPT 有了钱包，Skylight 已经替用户安排了 4850 万顿饭
zh.brief: 周六有正经新闻。OpenAI 用 ChatGPT Wallet 取代 Instant Checkout，令牌卡加刷脸确认，让代理替美国 Pro 用户付款。Skylight 把 20 道 Joanna Gaines 食谱装进 Target 限定日历屏，并透露用户累计规划 4850 万顿饭，其中 3350 万顿在过去一年。HomeView 上的 Siri 拒绝给评测人开车库门后，苹果承诺 12 月修复；Alexa 短信购物在包括加拿大的 13 个国家全面开放；Tyson 的调查称 72% 的家长已经在用 AI 处理节日做饭。

items.title: OpenAI scraps Instant Checkout and gives ChatGPT a Wallet that pays with your face
items.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet on Nov 13, letting its 'dots' agents complete purchases for a user. It is limited to adult ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US with eligible US cards. You add a card once; before each purchase the screen shows the merchant, items, total and card, and you approve with Face ID or a fingerprint. Neither the agent nor the merchant sees the real card number, only a token from Visa, Mastercard or American Express. It replaces Instant Checkout, which OpenAI dropped as not flexible enough, and OpenAI says it takes no commission during the initial rollout.
items.relevance: Kora's meal plans end in an Instacart checkout. Wallet is the template for how agents will pay next year: one card on file, a per-purchase approval screen, tokenized credentials, and later spending limits by category and timeframe. OpenAI also published a merchant playbook, so the stores Kora may shop from are being told how to welcome agents.
items.take: Instant Checkout lasted under a year, which is long for an OpenAI payments product. Version two is a tokenized card and a Face ID prompt, which is to say Apple Pay with extra steps and a chatbot. Steal the approval screen anyway: merchant, items, total, card, one tap. Done.
items.runtu: At home the question is simpler: can a kid tell the agent to buy snacks? Face ID on every purchase is the right answer, and the spending caps OpenAI is still promising are what a shared kitchen screen needs on day one.

deep_analysis.what: ChatGPT Wallet is OpenAI's second attempt at letting its AI buy things. The first, Instant Checkout, let people buy inside a chat and was scrapped because it was not flexible enough. Wallet instead works inside conversations with OpenAI's agents, called dots. The user describes what they want, the agent searches the web, APIs or merchant feeds, the user picks an option, and the agent completes checkout either through a browser on the merchant's site or through a plugin that supports cart actions. Payment runs on tokens generated by Visa, Mastercard and American Express, so the agent and merchant never hold the real card number. Each purchase needs biometric approval after a screen showing merchant, items, total and card. Launch is limited to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and over with eligible US cards. The merchant remains the seller and handles returns and complaints, merchants and card issuers can reject purchases, and OpenAI says existing card rewards and bank dispute protections still apply. OpenAI's payments lead Chaya Nayak told CNBC the goal is to focus on merchants and network partners. OpenAI also released a Commerce Partner Playbook telling merchants how to adjust firewalls, supply product data and work with Stripe, Adyen and Riskified, because many sites still block AI agents as bots.
deep_analysis.impact: For Kora, the direct effect is zero this week: Canada is not included and most families are not $200-a-month Pro subscribers. The indirect effect is large. Every major agent now has a payment path: Meta's Muse, xAI's Grok Bot and Anthropic's agent already pay through single-use cards, and now OpenAI does too. That sets expectations for how a family assistant should handle money: a card on file once, a clear approval step with the total, no raw card numbers passed around, and spending limits the parent sets. It also puts pressure on retailers to stop blocking agents and publish structured product data, which makes it easier for any agent, including Kora's grocery ordering, to check out reliably. The playbook is a signal that merchants will soon distinguish between agents that identify themselves and bots that do not.
next: Watch for OpenAI's promised autonomous purchases within spending limits by category and timeframe; that is the model for a Kora family allowance on groceries.
Review Kora's Instacart handoff against Wallet's approval screen: merchant, items, total, payment method, one confirmation.
Check whether Instacart and Walmart adopt the Commerce Partner Playbook, and whether Canada gets Wallet before 2027.

zh.title: OpenAI 砍掉 Instant Checkout，给 ChatGPT 配了个刷脸付款的钱包
zh.summary: OpenAI 11 月 13 日上线 ChatGPT Wallet，让它的代理（dots）替用户完成购买。首批仅限美国的成年 ChatGPT Pro 订户，且需绑定美国发行的银行卡。用户只需添加一次卡片；每次购买前屏幕会显示商家、商品、总价和所用卡片，用 Face ID 或指纹确认。代理和商家都看不到真实卡号，只拿到 Visa、Mastercard 或美国运通生成的令牌。它取代了被 OpenAI 认为“不够灵活”而放弃的 Instant Checkout，OpenAI 表示首发阶段不收佣金。
zh.relevance: Kora 的膳食计划最后一步就是 Instacart 结账。Wallet 给出了明年代理付款的模板：卡片只绑一次、每单一个确认页、令牌化凭证、之后按品类和时段设消费上限。OpenAI 还发布了商家手册，Kora 可能对接的商店正在被教怎么欢迎代理。
zh.take: Instant Checkout 活了不到一年，按 OpenAI 支付产品的标准已经算长寿。第二版是一张令牌卡加一个刷脸确认，说白了就是多绕几步的 Apple Pay，再搭一个聊天机器人。确认页倒是值得照抄：商家、商品、总价、卡片，一键。完。
zh.runtu: 在家里问题更简单：孩子能不能让代理买零食？每单刷脸是对的，而 OpenAI 还在“承诺中”的消费上限，恰恰是一块共享的厨房屏第一天就该有的。

deep_analysis.what: ChatGPT Wallet 是 OpenAI 第二次尝试让 AI 直接买东西。第一次的 Instant Checkout 允许在聊天里直接下单，因“不够灵活”被砍掉。Wallet 改为只在 OpenAI 代理（dots）的对话里工作：用户说出需求，代理搜索网页、接口或商家商品库，用户选定后，代理通过商家网站的浏览器流程或支持购物车操作的插件完成结账。支付依靠 Visa、Mastercard 和美国运通生成的令牌，代理和商家都拿不到真实卡号。每笔购买都要先看到商家、商品、总价、卡片的确认页，再用生物识别通过。首发限美国 18 岁以上的 ChatGPT Pro 订户和合格的美国银行卡。商家仍是卖方，负责发货、退货和投诉；商家和发卡行可以拒绝交易，OpenAI 称原有的信用卡积分和银行争议保护依然有效。OpenAI 支付负责人 Chaya Nayak 对 CNBC 表示，重点是服务商家和卡组织伙伴。OpenAI 同时发布了《商业伙伴手册》，教商家调整防火墙、提供商品数据，并与 Stripe、Adyen、Riskified 配合，因为很多网站至今仍把 AI 代理当机器人拦掉。
deep_analysis.impact: 对 Kora 来说，本周的直接影响是零：加拿大不在首发名单，绝大多数家庭也不是每月 200 美元的 Pro 用户。间接影响却很大。现在每个主流代理都有了付款通道：Meta 的 Muse、xAI 的 Grok Bot、Anthropic 的代理已经通过一次性虚拟卡付款，OpenAI 也跟上了。这为家庭助手如何管钱定下了预期：卡片只绑一次、带总价的清晰确认步骤、不传递真实卡号、由家长设定的消费上限。它也在倒逼零售商停止拦截代理、提供结构化商品数据，这让包括 Kora 买菜在内的任何代理都更容易稳定结账。那份手册还有一个信号：商家很快会区分“亮明身份的代理”和“不亮身份的机器人”。
next: 关注 OpenAI 承诺的按品类和时段设限的自动购买，这就是 Kora 做“家庭买菜额度”的样板。
对照 Wallet 的确认页检查 Kora 的 Instacart 交接：商家、商品、总价、支付方式，一次确认。
看 Instacart 和沃尔玛是否采纳《商业伙伴手册》，以及加拿大能否在 2027 年前用上 Wallet。

items.title: Skylight puts 20 Joanna Gaines recipes on its Target calendar, and says users have planned 48.5 million meals
items.summary: Skylight and Hearth & Hand with Magnolia added 20 recipes from Joanna Gaines' cookbooks, including Sunday Pot Roast, Chicken Pot Pie and Sheet Pan Nachos, to the limited-edition Calendar 2 sold at Target, at no extra cost. Users browse a recipe on the Calendar, add it to the meal plan and turn the ingredients into a grocery list inside Skylight. Skylight said customers have planned 48.5 million meals, 33.5 million of them in the last 12 months. Skylight president Aviv Gilboa said dinner starts long before anyone turns on the stove.
items.relevance: This is the first hard number on how much Skylight's meal planner gets used, and it is accelerating: more than two thirds of all meals ever planned on Skylight happened in the past year. Skylight is adding trusted-brand recipes; Kora plans from fridge photos and orders through Instacart. Both bets say dinner is the daily habit that keeps a family screen alive.
items.take: Twenty recipes from a cookbook, dressed up as a press release, and the real news is buried in paragraph four: 33.5 million meals in a year. Skylight's calendar is quietly a meal planner that happens to show the soccer schedule. Count your own meals, then publish them.
items.runtu: Dinner decided by Tuesday is worth more to a family than a celebrity name. If a recipe turns into a grocery list in two taps, that is the part people will actually use, and Kora should be faster at it.

zh.title: Skylight 把 20 道 Joanna Gaines 食谱装进 Target 限定日历屏，并透露用户已规划 4850 万顿饭
zh.summary: Skylight 与 Hearth & Hand with Magnolia 合作，把 Joanna Gaines 食谱书里的 20 道菜（如周日炖牛肉、鸡肉派、烤盘玉米片）免费加到 Target 独售的限定版 Calendar 2 上。用户在日历屏上浏览食谱、加进本周膳食计划，再一键把食材变成购物清单，全程不出 Skylight。Skylight 称用户累计已规划 4850 万顿饭，其中 3350 万顿发生在过去 12 个月。Skylight 总裁 Aviv Gilboa 说，晚饭早在开火之前就开始了。
zh.relevance: 这是 Skylight 膳食计划使用量的第一个硬数字，而且在加速：历史上三分之二以上的规划餐数都发生在最近一年。Skylight 在加名牌食谱，Kora 靠冰箱照片做计划并通过 Instacart 下单。两家都在赌同一件事：晚饭是让家庭屏活下来的每日习惯。
zh.take: 一本食谱书里的 20 道菜，包装成一篇新闻稿，真正的新闻埋在第四段：一年 3350 万顿饭。Skylight 的日历悄悄成了一个顺带显示足球课表的膳食计划器。先把自己的餐数算清楚，再大声说出来。
zh.runtu: 对一家人来说，周二就定好晚饭比名人头衔值钱得多。食谱两下就变成购物清单，这才是大家真会用的部分，Kora 得做得更快。

items.title: Apple promises a December update after Siri on HomeView refused to open a reviewer's garage
items.summary: Apple told tech journalist Joanna Stern it plans a HomeView software update in December to fix Siri failing home-control tasks. In her review, Siri refused to open her garage door or unlock her front door even though the device recognized her, and once told her 'I don't have a camera to see you.' Early owners on Reddit and the MacRumors forums report Siri refusing to set timers while claiming it needs a newer OS, trouble opening Safari, and one unit stuck in an update loop. Other reviewers split: ZDNET had Siri run a multi-step blinds, lights and TV request, while Tom's Guide found Siri could only offer to call a restaurant where Alexa+ completed the task.
items.relevance: Apple's first week in the kitchen sets the bar: the hardware wins the reviews, the assistant's reliability decides them. Kora's 'Hey Kora' voice will be judged by the same test. Timers, calendar and chores have to work every time, with no phone in the room.
items.take: A $299 screen that recognizes your face and then refuses to open the door for you is not security, it is a doorman with amnesia. The fix ships in December, which is also when the return window closes. Reliability is the feature.
items.runtu: A timer that argues back is the one thing a kitchen screen cannot do. If Kora gets timers, calendar and chores right every single time, that beats Siri's launch week by a mile.

zh.title: HomeView 上的 Siri 拒绝给评测人开车库门，苹果承诺 12 月推更新修复
zh.summary: 苹果告诉科技记者 Joanna Stern，计划在 12 月推送 HomeView 软件更新，修复 Siri 无法执行家居控制的问题。在她的评测中，设备明明认出了她，Siri 却拒绝开车库门和前门，还说过一句“我没有摄像头看不到你”。Reddit 和 MacRumors 论坛上的首批用户反映，Siri 拒绝设定时器并声称需要更新系统，打不开 Safari，还有一台卡在更新循环里。其他评测看法分裂：ZDNET 让 Siri 一口气完成了窗帘、灯和电视的多步指令，Tom's Guide 则发现 Siri 只会提议“帮你打电话给餐厅”，而 Alexa+ 直接把事办了。
zh.relevance: 苹果进厨房的第一周划出了标准：硬件赢口碑，助手的可靠性决定评分。Kora 的“Hey Kora”语音会被同样的尺子量。计时器、日历、家务必须每次都对，房间里没有手机也一样。
zh.take: 一块 299 美元的屏幕，认出你的脸之后拒绝给你开门，这不叫安全，叫失忆的门童。修复 12 月才到，刚好也是退货期截止的时候。可靠性本身就是功能。
zh.runtu: 会跟你顶嘴的计时器，是厨房屏唯一不能犯的错。Kora 要是能把计时器、日历和家务每一次都做对，就已经甩开 Siri 的首发周一大截。

items.title: Alexa for Shopping opens text ordering to everyone, and is now live in 13 countries including Canada
items.summary: Amazon said on Nov 13 that shopping by text with Alexa is 'widely available to all Alexa for Shopping customers,' a week after an invite-only US start. A texted request makes Alexa search products, build a cart, buy and send delivery updates. Alexa for Shopping, which combines the Rufus assistant with Alexa+, is now fully available in 13 countries including the US and Canada, with beta in the UAE and Turkey. A PYMNTS Intelligence report found 59% of AI-assisted purchases are completed at Amazon.
items.relevance: Amazon is turning the household shopping list into a chat thread in both of Kora's markets. Kora's edge is that its list starts from a meal plan and a fridge photo, not from Amazon's catalog. The risk is that families get used to texting a store instead of asking the kitchen screen.
items.take: Amazon blocked Muse from its store, then built a text agent that only shops at Amazon, and calls it choice. Fifty-nine percent of agent purchases already land there, so the walled garden is working fine. Own the list before Amazon does.
items.runtu: Texting 'we're out of milk' on a school night and having it just arrive is genuinely useful. What I would watch is whose brands end up in the cart when nobody is choosing.

zh.title: Alexa 购物助手向所有用户开放短信下单，已在包括加拿大的 13 个国家上线
zh.summary: 亚马逊 11 月 13 日表示，用短信让 Alexa 购物“已向所有 Alexa for Shopping 用户全面开放”，距美国受邀测试仅一周。发一条短信，Alexa 就会搜商品、组购物车、下单并推送配送进度。这个把 Rufus 助手和 Alexa+ 合在一起的功能，现已在包括美国和加拿大的 13 个国家正式上线，另在阿联酋和土耳其测试。PYMNTS Intelligence 的报告称，59% 的 AI 辅助购买最终在亚马逊完成。
zh.relevance: 亚马逊正在 Kora 的两个市场把全家购物清单变成一条聊天线程。Kora 的优势是清单从膳食计划和冰箱照片出发，而不是从亚马逊的货架出发。风险是家庭习惯了给商店发短信，而不是问厨房里的屏。
zh.take: 亚马逊先把 Muse 挡在店门外，再做一个只在亚马逊买东西的短信代理，然后管这叫“选择”。59% 的代理购买已经落在它家，围墙花园运转良好。清单要先握在自己手里，别等亚马逊来握。
zh.runtu: 上学日的晚上发一句“牛奶没了”，第二天就到，这是真有用。我会盯着的是，没人挑的时候，购物车里最后进的是谁家的牌子。

items.source: Tyson Foods via Action News Jax
items.title: Survey: 72% of parents have used AI for a holiday cooking task, and the meals between holidays stress them most
items.summary: A Savanta survey of 1,000 Americans for Tyson Foods, published Nov 12 as sponsored content, found 51% have used AI for at least one holiday cooking task, rising to 72% of parents. Top uses were recipe inspiration (32%), grocery lists (24%) and meal planning (23%). 56% said the days between holiday celebrations are more stressful than the holiday itself, and 58% said deciding what to cook before a holiday is harder than planning the holiday meal. The survey ran Sept 29 to Oct 6 with a 3.1 point margin of error.
items.relevance: The stress is not Thanksgiving dinner, it is the Tuesday after. That is exactly the gap Kora's fridge-photo meal plan and Instacart order fill, and the survey says parents are already asking AI for help with it. A seasonal pitch for Kora writes itself.
items.take: A chicken company paid for a survey that found people are tired of cooking, and the one number worth keeping is that three in four parents already ask AI. The holiday feast is handled by grandma. The leftover Wednesday is open. Take it.
items.runtu: Right for once. Nobody needs help with the turkey, they need Thursday's dinner when everyone is tired and the fridge is full of odd leftovers. A screen that turns leftovers into a plan earns its counter space that week.

zh.title: 调查：72% 的家长已用 AI 处理过节日做饭任务，最累的其实是节与节之间的饭
zh.summary: Savanta 为 Tyson Foods 做的 1000 人全美调查（11 月 12 日以赞助内容发布）显示，51% 的美国人至少用 AI 做过一项节日烹饪任务，家长中这一比例达 72%。最常见的用途是找菜谱灵感（32%）、列购物清单（24%）和做膳食计划（23%）。56% 的人觉得节日之间的那几天比节日当天更累，58% 的人认为节前“今天吃什么”比节日大餐更难决定。调查于 9 月 29 日至 10 月 6 日进行，误差 3.1 个百分点。
zh.relevance: 压力不在感恩节大餐，而在节后的周二。这正是 Kora 冰箱照片膳食计划加 Instacart 下单填的坑，而调查说家长们已经在找 AI 帮忙了。Kora 的季节性文案可以直接写了。
zh.take: 一家鸡肉公司花钱做调查，发现大家做饭做累了，唯一值得记住的数字是四分之三的家长已经在问 AI。节日大餐有外婆管。剩菜周三没人管。拿下它。
zh.runtu: 这次说对了。没人需要帮忙烤火鸡，需要的是周四那顿饭：人人都累，冰箱里全是零零碎碎的剩菜。能把剩菜变成一份计划的屏，那一周就配得上台面的位置。

items.title: Bots are impersonating consumer AI agents, and agents are logging in as humans, says Cequence
items.summary: Cequence Security found an online marketplace took 414,210 visits in one October week from traffic using a popular consumer AI agent's name; every visit hit the sign-in page and failed, a credential-stuffing attack about 1.5 times all genuine agent traffic the firm counted across five industries. At a Tier 1 telecom, a newly launched personal agent pushed automated logins from about 100 a day to 19,000 to 32,000, completing multi-factor authentication and adding devices to carts while presenting as a desktop browser. Across 281,627 genuine agent visits, 85% read pages or compared products and about one in seven booked, bought or managed an account. Cequence's advice: judge what a session does, and add step-up checks on payments.
items.relevance: Kora Plus places calls and Kora shops at Instacart on families' behalf, so Kora is the 'agent' in these logs. Retailers are being told to score behavior and add friction on payments, which means Kora's ordering flows should expect more checks and should identify themselves honestly.
items.take: The scammers wear the agent's name, the agents wear a human's browser, and the security vendors sell the glasses. The advice is sound anyway: watch what a session does, not what it says it is. Kora's agents should announce themselves before a firewall does it for them.
items.runtu: For a family this is the boring kind of important: if a bot can pretend to be the assistant, the assistant needs a lock the bot cannot pick. Approval at home for every purchase, honest identity on the way out.

zh.title: Cequence：机器人在冒充消费级 AI 代理，代理又在冒充真人登录
zh.summary: Cequence Security 发现，一家在线集市在 10 月的一周内收到 414,210 次打着某知名消费级 AI 代理名号的访问，全部直奔登录页且全部失败，是一次撞库攻击，流量约为该公司当周在五个行业统计到的全部真实代理访问的 1.5 倍。在一家一级电信运营商，某新上线的个人代理把自动登录从每天约 100 次推到 19,000 到 32,000 次，它们能通过多因素验证、把设备加进购物车，却伪装成普通桌面浏览器。在 281,627 次真实代理访问中，85% 在读页面或比价，约七分之一在预订、购买或管理账户。Cequence 的建议：看会话做了什么，并在付款环节加一道验证。
zh.relevance: Kora Plus 替家庭打电话，Kora 替家庭在 Instacart 买菜，所以在这些日志里 Kora 自己就是“代理”。零售商正被告知要按行为打分、在付款处加阻力，这意味着 Kora 的下单流程要预期更多检查，并且诚实亮明身份。
zh.take: 骗子披着代理的名字，代理披着真人的浏览器，安全厂商则负责卖眼镜。建议倒是对的：看会话做什么，别听它说自己是谁。Kora 的代理最好自己先报上名来，别等防火墙替你报。
zh.runtu: 对一家人来说，这是无聊但重要的那种事：机器人能假装成助手，助手就得有把机器人撬不开的锁。在家每笔购买都确认，出门亮明身份。
